annotations.title: Save and read a web page

description: Read any web page as clean Markdown and keep a copy that stays the same even if the page changes or disappears. Returns the page's text in the answer, plus a short snip.link link and QR code for it, and the saved copy as Markdown, plain text, a full-page screenshot, a PDF and a web archive (each at the short link with an ending: .md, .txt, .jpg, .pdf, .mhtml). Free, no account needed. Use this when the user wants to read, quote, cite, summarize, archive or share a web page, or asks for a page as Markdown, text, a screenshot or a PDF. A page anyone saved in the last day comes back at once; pass fresh for the page as it is now.

formats.description: Only these formats (faster for just the text). Default: all of them.

fresh.description: Load the page again even if it was saved in the last day. Default false.

presets.description: Owned Library ids, one per kind. Omit for account defaults; [] skips Library defaults. Explicit link settings win.

url.description: The http or https page to save.
